briefing.text: Information Technology still leads attention on all three feeds (news buzz 86.5, X 93.7, Reddit 94.1), with NVDA, AMD and MU the common names; buzz moved little day on day (news -1.9, X +0.3, Reddit -1.1), and Reddit mentions fell 42%. On news, Health Care rose to #2 (buzz +2.7 day on day, +2.9 over the week, mentions +59%, sentiment 0.35; INSM, SNY, MDT, MRNA), and Consumer Discretionary climbed from #6 to #3 (+2.2, mentions +53%; AMZN, TSLA, DKS). Utilities (-2.4) and Energy (-2.0, mentions -25%) were the main news fallers. On X, Health Care rose from #6 to #4 (+1.5, +2.0 over the week) while Energy buzz slipped 1.6 with mentions down 65% (OKLO, CVX). On Reddit, Consumer Staples edged up to #7 (+1.2; WMT, DLTR, COST).

URBN #1: earnings analysis plus a headline that the stock crashed on Wednesday (-10% on the day); the news explains the rank, as the move is 3.8 sigmas.
DKS #2: 'Foot Locker shows signs of life at Dick's' with 73 positive and 0 negative articles; explains the high rank.
BBIO #3: Canaccord raised its price target to $115 from $108 (buy); a modest catalyst that fits the +4.5% day.
BBY #4: Best Buy sticks with nationwide store closure plans and Black Friday discount stories; adds to attention but is not new.
META #5: WhatsApp message scheduling and tech sell-off coverage; routine product news, so the jump from #23 comes more from volume and the price move than the headlines.
TOL #6: a home community announcement and an institutional-holding note; minor, so it does not explain the rank (earnings are due 12-07).
DLTR #7: BNP Paribas Exane raised its target to $115 (underperform) and a quant-ratings mention; heavy positive news flow, 85 positive articles.
DG #8: preview coverage ahead of Q3 earnings next week (12-03); explains the attention.

URBN leads (score 0.93) on the broadest set of strong inputs: attention 2.5x normal, X attention 2.8x, volume 2.1x normal and a 3.8-sigma price move (-10% on the day), with a Kalshi KPI market as catalyst. DKS is #2 (0.92) mostly on attention: 3.3x normal overall and 4.2x on X, with a +20% five-day move, but volume is below normal (0.6x). BBIO is #3 (0.90) on attention 2.1x and X attention 2.6x plus a 1.5-sigma move after the price-target raise; volume is light (0.4x) and it has no scheduled catalyst.
